title: One cull lane fixes or deletes each guard or check with a recorded wrong refusal
why: Owner ruling R5, 15:04 CST Nov 10 ("option e works for now with a revisit maybe to threshold lanes if it turns out to be problematic", relayed by the retrospective session).
note: Source: the false alarm lines in docs/debts/notes.md (about 60, retrospective count). For each guard or check, fix or delete, whichever costs less. After the cull, wrong refusals are notes only; revisit threshold lanes (3 recorded wrong refusals gets its own lane) only if they become a problem. Record: decision cull-rules (branch cull-false-alarms-once). Restart plan stage 3 step 6 sets when it runs.
